title: Brand mark · Social media avatar
slide_intent: Teach designers to identify a program in a small square where a complete lockup may be difficult to read.
strategic_value: A recognizable symbol can identify the shared movement while a localized name and curve help distinguish accounts in a feed.
demonstration: Two generic avatars reverse the red and white symbol. Four local examples place color curves and short program identifiers beneath the symbol.
practical_value: Choose the generic or local avatar for the account. Keep the program’s name or abbreviation in the account name as well.

content_islands.name: Avatar guidance
content_islands.spec: Distinguish generic, localized and account-naming guidance at left.

content_islands.name: Generic pair
content_islands.spec: Place white-on-red and red-on-white squares at the top of the main field.

content_islands.name: Localized strip
content_islands.spec: Align four equally sized avatars beneath the generic pair. Preserve the symbol while varying curve colors and local labels.
